items.label: Voice-Matched Outreach
items.title: Cold outreach and follow-ups, drafted in your own voice -
items.title_emphasis: I use it to book these calls.
items.description: Same style-learning engine as Build 02, pointed at outreach. It drafts first-touch emails and follow-ups that sound like you wrote them, not a template. Built it for a client first. Now it runs my own prospecting, this site included.

items.label: Automatic Social Media Posts
items.title: Cut 6 hours of weekly social media content tasks to
items.description: One event starts the chain. Update emails and feedback requests go straight out, and the system drafts the LinkedIn, WhatsApp and Facebook posts in your own voice, learned from a sample of your writing. Not a template. A stats page tracks how they land. The only thing a human does is hit approve.

items.label: Construction Tender
items.title: Reads a whole construction tender pack and tells you
items.description: Stage one. Next up is the bid writer, which checks every claim in the answer against the company's own records.
flow: Pack in | PDFs, Word files, spreadsheets and scans, built for construction and groundworks firms
Reads every page | Pulls out the deadline, what to send back, the requirements and the contract risks
Every answer quoted | Shows the page and exact quote, re-read from it rather than taken on the AI's word. If it can't find it, it says so.
Go or no-go | Checked against your company. Stage one; the bid writer is next.
